title: Prakriti
description: An environmental awareness and eco-action campaign celebrating biodiversity, conservation, and green culture.
longDescription: Prakriti was our landmark green initiative featuring campus sustainability challenges, tree plantation drives, and student-led environmental awareness sessions celebrating ecological balance.

title: Innovate 2.0
description: An innovation and ideation summit fostering sustainable tech solutions and green engineering.
longDescription: Our flagship event that brings together student innovators, green tech enthusiasts, and mentors for an intensive two-day hackathon and exhibition exploring sustainable engineering models.

title: Prakriti 2.0
description: The second edition of our premier ecological festival promoting zero waste, climate action, and green innovations.
longDescription: Prakriti 2.0 expanded our eco-conscious mission with interactive workshops, upcycling competitions, and panel discussions on sustainable living and youth-driven climate initiatives.

title: Handicrafts Using Wastes
description: Showcasing eco-friendly handcrafted creations, upcycled designs, and sustainable craftsmanship.
longDescription: A month-long exhibition and workshop series highlighting sustainable handicrafts, zero-waste art, and traditional eco-conscious craftsmanship made by students and artisans.

title: Clean Air Initiative
description: Awareness drive and symposium focused on clean air, emissions reduction, and local environmental health.
longDescription: Interactive session exploring urban air quality management, monitoring techniques, and actionable student-led green interventions to curb atmospheric pollutants.

title: Eco Conscious Fest
description: Annual multi-day environmental celebration, green exhibitions, competitions, and workshops.
longDescription: Our eco-festival that brings together the campus community for sustainability showcases, renewable energy challenges, tree plantation, and eco-initiatives.

title: Gracias
description: A celebration and thanksgiving ceremony honouring contributors, volunteers, and sustainability champions.
longDescription: Annual felicitation ceremony dedicated to recognising outstanding volunteers, team leads, and faculty mentors driving Greenovation Club initiatives.

title: Club Orientation 2026
description: Welcome and orientation session for new club inductees and prospective members.
longDescription: Official orientation introducing the missions, upcoming projects, and core units of Greenovation Club to new students.
